notes.title: What is this? An update for ANTS?
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where lich summons would stop responding.

notes.title: Update 1.3 - Quality of Un-Life
notes.notes:
Four hotkeys can be assigned to the equipment bar by holding 1,2,3, or 4 and clicking. Hotkeys will reappear automatically if playing a new mode and you re-unlock the slot. (re-unlock? is that a word?). You can clear the hotkey by doing the same process on the existing hotkey.
Adjusted tutorial
After getting two game over screens, Joey bag-o-bones will appear at the start to offer to let you skip the first few levels.
One new unlockable summon
One new unlockable item
Small handful of higher powered previously existing items
New achievements
UI improvements
Bodies dug up by gravediggers now despawn in 45 seconds.
Bugfix for silly trinket items being deleted between levels.
Bugfix for bridge level villager pathfinding.
Bugfix for throne level villager pathfinding.
For each "Jumbo" you spawn, the next will have slightly quieter stomping noises to make them less annoying.
New unlocks for beating Necropolis Wave 35. These are now rewarded at the start of a game instead of in the store.
A few fun secrets :D

notes.title: Update 1.2 - 200% More Tornado
notes.notes:
Soul Tornado spell now makes three tornadoes instead of one, which is approximately 200% more fun.
Tornado sound effect reduced.
Base level lightning buffed.
Ghosts keep full movement speed when retreating and on possess cooldown.
Hitbox fix for "punch villager" when targeting an enemy above it.
Small performance improvement to amount of units the game can handle at once.
Minor level layout / decor changes.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Signs of life
notes.notes:
-Added some helpful signs for the player
-Added some unhelpful signs for the player
-Fixed enemy spawns at road level and supercrypt level causing FPS drops
-Fixed achievement "Boney Buddies" (click "unlocks" on the main menu to get achievement instantly if you already accomplished this)
-Fixed boss fight pathfinding
-Critter corpse item description updated
-Minor tweaks to level layouts
-Minor tweaks to optional color palettes
-Common sound effects should play less often for better audio experience
-Added music to secret ritual
-Increased references to Evil Dead
